title:
A link (reference) to a footnote in parsed Markdown, such as "[^1]" or "[^foo]".

It is also possible to use "inline footnotes" without a separate body: `text^[footnote body]`. This means
there will be no separate body in the Markdown tree and the renderer is responsible for using the children of
the inline footnote correctly at the end of the document.

@see MarkdownFootnoteBody
name: MarkdownFootnoteLink
